title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
description: In Cool Girl Aesthetics, join Mia as she creates her ultimate trendy look! Start by customizing her Stanley cup with fun colors, prints, and accessories. Then, style her headphones, giving them a unique vibe. Next, design her manicure with cool colors, rings, and temporary tattoos for a stylish edge. Complete the look with makeup options like face stickers, colorful braces, and more. Dive into this fun, creative dress-up, and makeover game for endless aesthetic options.

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: ASMR Makeover & Makeup Studio
description: Get ready to dive into the world of beauty and creativity! ASMR Makeup & Makeover Studio offers an incredible opportunity to give your virtual model a stunning makeover. This isn't just any makeover game — it's an immersive experience that combines relaxation and excitement through the power of ASMR!

title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
description: Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes. Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

title: ASMR Beauty Homeless
description: One of our patrons came in today with her homeless friend, Anna, who is in need of urgent hygiene care. Let’s assist the doctor in cleaning her body, teeth, and the area around her piercing. After the treatment, style her in the best outfit!

title: Hair Salon: Beauty Salon
description:
Get ready to unleash your inner hairstylist with the adorable and entertaining game Hair Salon: Beauty Salon Spa! ?

This charming simulation game allows you to run your very own hair salon, where you can give your cute and quirky customers the hair style of their dreams.
From washing, styling hair and providing luxurious jewelry & makeup accessories, there's never a dull moment in this delightful game.

title: ASMR Beauty Treatment
description: OMG! Our patient arrived with a dirty, pimply face and teeth problems. Help her take care of these issues and showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Beauty Treatment game. After completing the treatment, style our patient with the best outfit and makeup from our collections to create the perfect look!

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: K-Pop Hunter Halloween Fashion
description: Step into the glamorous world of K-Pop Hunter Halloween Fashion! In this fun dress-up game, you become the ultimate stylist, creating spooky yet stylish looks for popular K-Pop stars. Mix and match Halloween costumes, trendy hairstyles, and cool accessories to design jaw-dropping outfits for the season’s most exciting event.

title: Paper Doll Diary: Dress Up DIY
description: ? Welcome to Paper Doll Diary: Doll DressUp, where the timeless charm of DIY paper dolls meets the exhilarating world of fashion dress up! Step into a realm of creativity and style where you become the master stylist of your enchanting paper doll dress up. With an expansive wardrobe featuring over 1000 fashion items, including the latest in trendy attire, distinctive accessories, diverse hairstyles, and soothing ASMR makeup touches, your creative potential is limitless.

title: Stylish Nail Art
description: Do you love nail art and cute fashion styles? Stylish Nail art is the perfect game for you! Create your own beautiful nail designs with colorful nail polish, adorable stickers, and stylish accessories. Try different themes to make every nails look unique and trendy! Mix and match colors, patterns, and decorations to show your creativity and fashion sense. After finishing your nail art, choose a pretty background to complete your masterpiece. Simple, relaxing, and full of fun!

title: Mega Makeup - Seasons Best
description: Mega Makeup Seasons Best is the ultimate makeup game where creativity knows no bounds! Design stunning looks for each month of the year with vibrant eyeshadows, bold lipsticks, sparkling gems, and stylish accessories. Choose between Pro Mode for precision or Freestyle Mode for endless color combinations. Complete your seasonal masterpiece with matching jewelry and hair accessories. Perfect for makeup enthusiasts, this game is your go-to for all things beauty and style! Play now!

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa
description: ASMR Beauty Japanese Spa is a relaxing style game where you guide a charming girl through a soothing Japanese hair spa filled with calming treatments and revitalizing masks. Once refreshed, dress her in elegant kimonos, choose delicate accessories, and personalize her look with stunning hairstyles, makeup, and shoes. It's your peaceful retreat into beauty, fashion, and creative expression.

title: Fashion World Simulator
description: It's time for some super cool styles! Be a fabulous fashionista stylist and dress up a supermodel to rule all the fashion runways around the world! Get ready to dive into the ultimate dress-up experience and show your creativity. This game is all about makeovers, dress-ups, and decorating new cool stuff. Compete and vote for your style to win the competition. Join us and start your fashion journey!

title: Pet Salon Simulator
description: It's a very busy day at the pet salon! Jump in and give our furry friends the full treatment. Wash, groom, and style them to look even more charming and adorable. Show off your grooming skills and create picture-perfect transformations that will make every pet leave feeling proud and confident!

title: Lost Puppy Rescue and Care
description: Welcome to Lost Puppy Rescue and Care. A small pup is lost in the rain, cold and alone. He’s not sure who to trust—but with your care, that starts to change. Gently clean him up, feed him, and help him feel safe again. This calm, story-like game is all about kindness, connection, and giving one little dog a second chance.

title: Funny Angela Haircut
description: Give Angela the best hairstyle ever! Enjoy tons of professional tools like curling irons, blow dryers, scissors, magic hair growing spray, and so much more! Dye her hair in any variety of colors. Complete the makeover with stylish outfit, mix and match cute clothes and dress up Angela to become more fashionable!

title: Fashion Makeover Dash
description: Ready for a fun fashion adventure? In Fashion Makeover Dash, you can run through the mall, collect cute outfits, stylish accessories, and shiny coins along the way! After the dash, it’s makeover time! Dress up your character with all the fashion items you collected and create the cutest look ever. You can also use coins to decorate your room and make it extra stylish. Run, collect, dress up, and have fun in the ultimate fashion makeover game!

title: Barbiecore Aesthetics
description: Step into a whimsical world of pastel dreams and retro vibes with the Barbiecore Aesthetics dress-up game! Test your fashionista skills as you mix and match vibrant colors, fluffy textures, and vintage-inspired patterns to create the most stunning doll-like outfits. From quirky accessories to flouncy dresses, this game offers endless possibilities to express your style. Embrace the Barbiecore trend and let your creativity soar as you curate the perfect wardrobe for our beloved fashion icon.

title: Knee Case Simulator
description: Knee Case Simulator is a delightful beauty and doctor simulation game where you get to showcase your medical skills and fashion sense! Help Tiara recover from her knee injury and give her a stylish makeover once she's feeling better.

description: Welcome to Magic Beauty Makeup, a casual and relaxing girl makeover game on H5games4u. The girl is in trouble with her appearance. Help her return to her original beauty with skin care and makeup methods. You will act as a makeover artist who does skin care, applies facial makeup, and designs a perfect look in the virtual fashion salon. And the best part? All the makeup procedures are done just by clicking and dragging.

description: Welcome to the world of daring alternative glamour! Meet two star heroines - Sydney and Sabrina. Help them go beyond the usual and try on the most daring alternative images: from a gentle soft-grunge princess to a gloomy rock diva. In the game, you can make bright makeup with arrows and sparkles; create unusual hairstyles; collect memorable outfits from tops, corsets, mini skirts and oversized jackets. Create your own collection of stunning Alt-girl looks!

Hit the mall, shop as many items as you can before the time runs out, and then return for another styling adventure. Explore an array of lipstick hues, experiment with smoky eyes, or go for colorful shadows, and browse through fashionable dresses, trendy tops, and stylish shoes. Complete the look with dazzling accessories and designer bags.

Test your fashion guru skills and transform high school wallflowers into show-stopping style icons. Rack up those style credits with a fabulous curated wardrobe and accessories. This dress-up game is where high school drama meets fashion week, straight from your screen. Happy playing!

description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style brings romance, fashion, and K-pop glamour together in one stylish dress-up experience. Help your favorite K-pop hunters transform their looks for Valentine’s Day with stunning outfits, flawless makeup, and charming accessories.

Perfect for makeup lovers and enthusiasts of holiday-themed games alike, this girl game takes you on a journey filled with creativity, color, and Christmas cheer! title: K-Wedding Dream

Combine tradition and modern fashion by creating wedding looks for lovers. Choose the perfect makeup, hairstyle and jewelry to highlight their unique style and charm. Let each of your choices reflect the emotions and dreams of the characters, turning this day into a real fairy tale!

description: Welcome to the dress-up game, in which the pop diva tries on three completely different fashionable looks: a youthful preppy bow, a cowboy outfit and a glamorous stage look. In addition, you can experiment with hairstyles and change the makeup of the heroine. Complete the images with accessories: glasses, hats and jewelry. Choose clothes and combine elements from different sets to create delicate, daring or superstar bows. Turn Taylor into an icon of any style!

title: Girls Photoshopping Dressup
description: Today the girls are going out for a very special photoshoot! Enter the photostudio and complete all tasks that photographer is giving you. Use the money to purchase nice clothes and dress them up! Choose between Lisa and Maria, both have a different set of items to wear. Become a princess, a skater or maybe even pikachu.  Have fun in this Girls Photoshopping Dressup game!

title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
description: Get ready for a spooky and stylish adventure in Iconic Halloween Costumes! Help three BFFs pick out their perfect Halloween looks, from royal Glinda and Bridgerton-inspired outfits to edgy Beetlejuice vibes and cowgirl-chic styles. Customize their costumes with tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to create iconic Halloween outfits. Play now and let the fashion fun begin!

title: Mommy BFFs Pregnant Check Up
description: Go to the doctors with two cute BFFs who are about to become mommies for the first time! There are a lot of fun tools you can use to take their temperature and measure their heart beat. After you've made sure everything is going well, go ahead and give the two mommies fresh fruits and healthy shakes to keep their vitamin levels up. Play some music for the babies and choose a fun belly tattoo for each of them! This will be a fun day that will both remember dearly.

title: Tictoc KPOP Fashion
description: Help this cute girl to become tictoc kpop star by helping her to choose the right make up and clothes by following the hint. Make her look stylish on every reel. You can buy new items by getting many likes after posting the photo.

title: Fabulous Cute Unicorn Coloring Book
description: It’s time to draw, young artists! This time we have to color fabulous cute unicorns. Use the slide bar on the right to select the desired color. The palette of this game contains wonderful pastel shades. Drag the panel with the palette using the left mouse button. Enjoy this new game «Fabulous cute unicorn coloring book»!

title: Skinfluencer Beauty Routine
description: Embark on an extraordinary journey of self-expression and embracing imperfections with Skinfluencer Beauty Routine. Guided by Emma, discover the true meaning of beauty from within and embrace confidence in your own skin. Dive into the enchanting world of beauty, fashion, and self-discovery. Unleash your creativity, join Emma's quest to become the ultimate #skinfluencer, and conquer the virtual realm! Experience this brand-new makeover game for girls and let your unique beauty shine through.

title: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
description: Join us in the excitement as you follow the thrilling journey of teen Riri, who is preparing for the concert of a lifetime. From choosing the perfect outfit to applying stunning makeup, you'll get to walk her through all the steps of this beautifying process. But before you start the fun, be sure to help her customize her cowgirl hat, a signature item for the concert she will attend. Then go crazy with the makeup, dress her up in a jaw-dropping outfit, and accessorize for a complete look.

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
description: Test your makeup artist skills in Dazzling Divas Makeup! Inspired by My Little Pony, this colorful dress-up game lets you create magical makeup looks for three fabulous girls—Lila, Mimi, and Roxy. Style each diva with Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, and Rainbow Dash–inspired makeup, then complete their look with trendy tops and accessories. With endless outfit combos and sparkling vibes, this is the ultimate glam experience for fashion lovers!

description:
Create the lifestyle you always wanted and live а life of beauty and high fashion! Customize every aspect of your personal avatar by choosing the tone of your skin, your hairstyle, eyes, makeup, clothes, shoes, accessories, and more.
Design the apartment of your dreams, get the cutest pets you always wanted to have, and find the perfect boyfriend.
Become a member of a lady's club today, and make long-lasting friendships with other girls that love
fashion, beauty, and competition as much as you do!

description: Unpack style and surprises in What’s In My Bag? – the ultimate dress-up and makeup game for fashion lovers! Choose cute outfits, glam makeup, and trendy bags, then reveal what’s inside each one. From influencer props to girly goodies, every bag tells a story. Get creative, show off your style, and join the viral “what’s in my bag” trend now! Perfect for fans of dress-up games, makeup fun, and aesthetic vibes.

title: Autumn Glam Gala
description: Get ready for the ultimate fall beauty adventure at the Autumn Glam Gala! Help three BFFs create stunning makeup looks for the most anticipated gala of the season. From soft, natural tones to bold, sparkling colors, you’ll have endless fun choosing makeup, hairstyles, and glamorous outfits. Experiment with fall-inspired looks and fashion trends to ensure each girl shines at the gala. Are you ready to showcase your makeup artist skills? Play Autumn Glam Gala now and let the glam begin!

title: Shoe Designer
description: Wonderful news for all of you fashion divas who are obsessed with designer shoes! Fabulous new shoes designing game “Shoe Designer” is here to let you design your unique pumps, sandals or stilettos!

title: Fashion Heroes Academy
description: Welcome to the Academy of Fashion Heroines, a place where style and superpowers go hand in hand! Three brave girls entered the academy in order not only to reveal their abilities, but also to create their own unique image. And you will help them in this. Choose outfits for studying, training and super battles. Experiment with makeup and accessories. Let each schoolgirl become a superhero and a style icon at the same time!

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Barber Shop!
description: Your barber shop has opened! Help the guest to cut their ideal hairstyle! Be careful not to hurt customers by touching other places with the clipper!

title: Sleepy Princess Twins Birth
description: The sleepy princess is having twins! Call an ambulance and make sure the princess has enough water and oxygen while waiting. In order for her to also relax, call the prince before time runs out. Some cute kisses will help the future mommy for sure. Once you are at the hospital, you will meet the two cute babies. Take care of them by changing their diaper and feeding them. Soon the new family will be home, healthy and happy!

title: My Manga Avatar
description: Would you like to have your own manga avatar? In this fun new game you can create your own cool avatar, by exploring the options and choosing the features that represents you the most. You can play with shapes and colors in order to create the cutest face features and colorful, bold hair styles. Start by picking one of the characters and choose the eye, nose, mouth and eye brow shape. Make sure to chose a nice and expressive eye and lip color and when you are done add a nice skin tone before moving to the hair style. Your manga avatar would look great with pink or purple hair but pick the one you like the most. Make sure to create an expressive face with cute features, then move to the next part and dress up you lovely avatar. She can wear a glitzy pink top or a cool Mickey Mouse tank top. There are so many cool outfits so choose the one that represents you the most. Finally, you can select some nice accessories such as nerdy glasses, necklaces, headphones or shiny colorful bracelets. When you created the perfect avatar select a nice background and you are done. Don't forget to download your new avatar! Have fun playing this brand new My Manga Avatar game!

Surrounded by futuristic neon lights, the royal BFFs wait for you to join the fun and help them decide on the winning looks. Are you ready to join them in the Cyberpunk City Fashion game?

Transform into a festival goddess, beach babe, or blooming flower child in three exciting themed units. Grab your brushes, swipe on lipstick, and let your inner artist shine. Dance at festivals, relax by the beach or embrace nature's beauty. With Practice On Me, the possibilities are endless. Make waves, channel your inner mermaid, and bloom like a flower.
